verses.1: For Jehovah your God will bring you into the land that you are about to inherit. Many nations will be destroyed from before you: the Hittites, the Gibeals, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivvites, and the Yebusites. Seven mighty nations will be destroyed from before you.
verses.2: And give them to you, O LORD your God, before your eyes. But you must mark them with a mark, so that they will not be able to make any covenant with you. Do not trust them at all.
verses.3: And do not give them to your children. Do not give them to your sons, and do not take them as your own children.
verses.4: For he will take away your throne from you, and others will worship other gods instead. Then Jehovah will also reject you, and he will destroy you quickly.
verses.5: For if you do these things for them, then their altars will be destroyed, and their places of worship will be torn down. Their offerings will be burned, and their idols will be destroyed by fire.
verses.6: For you, O Holy One, are chosen by Jehovah your God to be His people, a people of choice among all the nations that lie before the earth.
verses.7: You are not the most important people among all nations. Yet Jehovah has chosen you, because you are the least important among all nations.
verses.8: For Jehovah loves you, and he has kept the covenant that was made with your ancestors. Therefore, Jehovah has brought you forth with strength, and he has saved you from being slaves under the rule of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt.
verses.9: And you shall know that Jehovah your God is the true God who keeps the covenant and the mercy for those who love Him, and who protects His commandments for ever.
verses.10: And he will repay those who hate him with their own hands. He will take them away from their homes; no one else will be able to harm them. He will repay those who hate him with their own hands.
verses.11: And you have kept the commandments, and the laws, and the judgments that I command you to carry out today.
verses.12: And because you heard these laws and kept them, and obeyed them, then Jehovah your God will fulfill to you the covenant and the blessings that were promised to your ancestors.
verses.13: And I will love you, bless you, and multiply your crops and the fruits of your land. Your cattle and your livestock will increase greatly. All your possessions on this land will be blessed to you, just as your ancestors were blessed.
verses.14: May it be blessed among all nations; there shall be no poverty or destitution in you.
verses.15: And Jehovah will remove from you all your diseases and all the evil things of Egypt that you knew would not be beneficial to you. He will give them over to those who hate you.
verses.16: And you shall eat all the nations that Yahweh your God gives you. Do not look at them with contempt, and do not worship their gods, for that would be too difficult for you.
verses.17: For if you say in your heart, “These nations are better than me; how can I possibly defeat them?”
verses.18: Do not be afraid of them. Remember what Jehovah your God has done for Pharaoh and for all the Egyptians.
verses.19: The great miracles that your eyes have seen, and the strong hands and arms, and the branches that Jehovah your God has brought forth from the vineyard. Thus will Jehovah your God do for all the nations who fear you.
verses.20: And also, Jehovah your God will send plagues upon them, until all those who remain behind and are hidden from your sight are destroyed.
verses.21: Do not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God is in your midst. He is a great and powerful God.
verses.22: And Jehovah your God will scatter those nations from before you, little by little. They won’t be able to stand against you anymore. Then, the death penalty will fall upon them.
verses.23: And Jehovah your God will give them to you before your eyes. And they will be used for great purposes, even until they are used up completely.
verses.24: And they shall be given into your hands. You will destroy their names from under heaven. No one shall stand before you until you have destroyed them completely.
verses.25: May their idols be burned in fire, so that they may not be able to taste gold or silver. And take them for yourself, so that you won’t be burdened by them, because this is the punishment from your God, your Lord.
verses.26: And do not bring any burden to your home. Then you will be as guilty as those who are punished. They will punish you and treat you with cruelty, for they are guilty themselves.
